headline: Deven Choksey recommends Sun Pharma, Cipla, and Indian IT for new investments
hook: Expert backs pharma giants and tech sector

summary: Market expert Deven Choksey has identified Sun Pharma and Cipla as top choices for fresh capital allocation. He also indicated positive upside potential for Indian IT companies. headline: Deven Choksey recommends Sun Pharma and Cipla while advising caution on Titan and Kalyan
hook: Expert picks select pharma and IT buys

modes.bear: High valuations in jewellery stocks and pharma mean investors should wait for corrections instead of buying now.
modes.bull: Sun Pharma and Cipla offer fresh buying opportunities, and IT stands to benefit from strong AI-related order inflows.
modes.simple: Market expert Deven Choksey likes Sun Pharma and Cipla for buying right now, sees potential in IT stocks due to AI, but says to wait for lower prices on jewellery brands like Titan.

summary: Deven Choksey, MD at DRChoksey Finserv, recommends fresh buying in Sun Pharma and Cipla while suggesting investors wait for market corrections in Divi's Labs and Laurus Labs. He is positive on Indian IT due to rising AI-related order inflows but advises waiting for lower valuations in jewellery stocks like Titan and Kalyan Jewellers. Indian retail investors tracking pharma and IT sectors can use these expert stances to calibrate entry points. This guidance helps long-term investors identify sector preferences amid shifting valuations.
why_it_matters: Guides your entry points across major pharma, IT, and retail stocks.
winners_losers: Sun Pharma gains / Titan wait for dips

hook: New peak for the Nifty Pharma index

Other major pharmaceutical companies including Mankind Pharma, Ipca Laboratories, Torrent Pharmaceuticals, Divis Laboratories, Cipla, and Aurobindo Pharma also gained around 2 percent each. hook: Margins expected to expand over next quarters

Growth was supported by its domestic branded prescription therapies and recent respiratory product approvals. Operating margins declined, but management expects improvement from upcoming product launches and specialty portfolio expansion.

headline: Cipla reports 35 percent drop in net profit for September quarter
hook: Profit slips despite steady US targets
summary: Cipla's net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, fell 35 per cent to ₹878 crore compared to the same period last year. Revenue for the quarter also declined to ₹7,404 crore from ₹7,589 crore. Despite ongoing supply issues, the company maintained its US revenue projection of $1 billion. Indian retail investors tracking pharmaceutical stocks should note the earnings contraction alongside steady overseas guidance.
why_it_matters: Cipla shares may face pressure as quarterly profit drops.

headline: Cipla reports Q2 North America revenue at $172 million with narrower margins
hook: Margins compress despite steady US revenues
